pluginText.pf.money: {"assessment":"free; nothing taken and nothing owed","hourly":"Per hour per person, billed weekly (every Friday) for the hours worked, each session's times listed","retainer":"A $500 retainer when the agreement is signed (example), taken off the last bill; the deposit cap comes from the state's form","over_estimate":"Hours past the estimate's top need the payer's yes first","who_pays":"The older adult, a family member or an agent under a power of attorney; the bill goes to whoever the agreement names","movers":"The moving company bills the family its own way; the business takes no fee on it and no referral fee unless it tells the family in writing","cancel":"A session cancelled less than 48 hours ahead may be billed 1 hour ($85, example), only if the owner confirms; never for a hospital stay or a death","remote_plan":"The $150 remote move plan is paid in full when booked; a late cancel may keep $20 of it, only with the owner's yes (example)","tips":"None","fee2":"Rosfield's $2 applies: one per confirmed booking; a whole move from one agreement is one job, so one $2","big_bills":"Bank transfer through the company's own Stripe for weekly bills over the owner's amount; paid once it clears. A check from an agent under a power of attorney also works: the lead texts 'paid check'."}
pluginText.pf.messages: {"never_in_texts":["Health, memory or care details, and money details","Door codes and lockbox codes","Why someone is moving: owner and staff texts never say it","Contract papers and lab or medical papers (secure page only, with a copy by email)"],"older_adult":"Texts go to the older adult only if they have a mobile and said yes; otherwise reminders go to the family contact, or by phone call where the older adult asked for calls","tone":"Plain and patient; no rushing; the older adult is spoken to directly, never about as if absent","languages":"English and Spanish","minors":"Never booked by a minor"}
pluginText.pf.staff: {"roles":"Move leads (Marta, Joel) run each move; move assistants help on packing and move days. Planners (Joan, Priya) take the planning calls and the remote plans.","licenses":"No person license; a background check for everyone in clients' homes","who_oks":"The owner OKs every agreement and any estimate change","stand_in":"The older adult keeps the same lead wherever possible; a new person is offered only with the older adult's or the family's OK first, never on silence","two_people":"Packing and move days need two people; sorting sessions can be one","never":"Staff never accept gifts or buy items from a client, never handle money or medicines, and never sign anything for the client"}
pluginText.pf.rules: {"agreement":"A written agreement before the first session, with the rate, the estimate range and the cancel terms; a written cancel period where the state's rules give one","decisions":"The older adult decides about their belongings whenever they can. When they can't, the person named in the agreement decides.","authority":"A power of attorney ends when the person dies; from then on, only the executor may decide about the belongings","partners":"Estate sale, donation, cleanout and moving companies are separate businesses the family picks and pays","records":"7 years"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"move_date_fixed":"A move-in date the community set can't move: the family decides, and no new person comes without their OK","hospital_stay":"Sessions pause with no fee while the older adult is in the hospital or rehab","death_during_move":"Every text to the older adult stops; sessions pause; the work goes on only once the executor confirms","older_adult_changes_mind":"The session stops and the people the older adult named are told; nothing is packed or thrown away against the older adult's wishes","family_disagrees":"Work on the disputed items waits for the named decision maker","nobody_answers":"Nobody answers the door at a session: the lead calls the older adult, then the family contact, before anything else; a fee is never asked until they're found safe","landline_only":"An older adult with only a landline gets reminder calls, or reminders go to the family contact","other":"All other edge cases are handled the generic way"}
